Name: Bypass All Doors or Unlock All Doors
Author: CodeKokeshi
Description:
Bypass All Door Restrictions

Have you ever tracked down an NPC to deliver a quest item or a birthday gift, only to find they’ve retreated to their room right when you needed them most? Or perhaps you sprinted across town to Pierre’s or Marnie's, only to arrive to a locked door?

We’ve all been there! Standing awkwardly outside a locked door because you're not "good enough friends" or because you missed a closing time by a few seconds. It’s frustrating, immersion-breaking, and a waste of a walk across town.

This mod removes the barriers. Whether it's a friendship requirement, a shop schedule, or a holiday closure, this mod lets you walk right in.

This mod gives you full control over which locks you want to ignore. Using the [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b], you can toggle the following:
[list]
[*][b]Bypass Friendship Locks:[/b] No more 2-heart requirement for NPC bedrooms. Walk in and deliver that gift whenever you want.
[*][b]Bypass Shop Hours:[/b] Need to buy seeds at midnight? Shops stay accessible regardless of the time.
[*][b]Bypass Special Closures:[/b] Access shops even on their "closed" days (like Pierre’s on Wednesdays).
[*][b]Bypass Festival Closures:[/b] Tired of the whole town locking down because there’s a festival in the evening? Now you can go about your business.
[*][b]Bypass Conditional Doors:[/b] Ignore doors locked behind specific Game State Queries (GSQ) or progress milestones.
[/list]
⚙️ Customizable Experience
You don't have to break the game if you don't want to. Every feature listed above can be turned [b]ON[/b] or [b]OFF[/b] in the settings. If you only want to bypass friendship locks but keep shop hours realistic, you can!

[b]Disclaimer:[/b]Please report any issues with a detailed description in the comments or bug section. I am a total beginner to Stardew Valley and its modding scene. [b]When I created this mod, my in-game progress was Spring 9, Year 1.[/b]
